canonical_mechanics_contract.residual: R(u, lambda, state) = lambda * F_ext - F_material - F_geometric - F_contact
canonical_mechanics_contract.free_dof_policy: Convergence and physical residual gates are evaluated on declared free degrees of freedom; constrained reactions are recovered from the physical system.
canonical_mechanics_contract.state_policy: Trial state is never externally committed until an accepted increment; failed iterations, rejected increments and restart failures must roll back atomically.
canonical_mechanics_contract.compatibility_note: Existing implementations use algebraically equivalent internal-minus-external residual conventions in places. WP01 must adapt them to this explicit contract without changing physical K/F definitions.

common_driver_requirements: A single public nonlinear-driver contract owns Newton iteration, convergence reporting, line-search policy, increment acceptance, cutback/retry and diagnostics.
Material, geometric and contact contributions compose through one residual/tangent assembly protocol.
No physics family may silently fall back to an unrelated solver or commit state outside the accepted-increment boundary.
Checkpoint/restart state must be versioned, validated and sufficient to reproduce the declared continuation state.

evidence_policy.prospective_contract: Every work package freezes observable definitions, numerical gates, scope, failure cases and oracle limitations before campaign execution.
evidence_policy.replay: At least two deterministic replays are required where a work package claims deterministic nonlinear behavior.
evidence_policy.promotion: No target becomes a maturity change without completed gates, evidence integrity and Owner approval.
